analysis: Philadelphia is without Jalen Hurts (now on IR), Saquon Barkley AND backup Will Shipley -- the model's automatic depth-stacking penalty kicked in because the Eagles are down their top two running backs, on top of losing their starting QB. The market has already caught up to this (Carolina favored on the road at -3), and the model agrees with no further spread edge beyond that.
Where there is a real gap is the total: 35.6 projected vs. a 39.5 market number, a near-4-point gap driven by the Eagles' offense being gutted at QB and RB simultaneously.
